description: A tiling window manager for Windows, with an animation engine, a status bar, a command palette and a configuration language that tells you when you have made a mistake.
notes: Shubbak is installed but not running, and there is no config until you write one:
shubbak config init          write a starter config: keys, the bar, the palette
shubbak-wm                   start the window manager now
shubbak autostart enable     and have it start at logon from now on
Run 'shubbak config-path' to see which file is in effect. The fully annotated
reference is shubbak.example.kdl, beside the executables.
This is the portable build, under your profile, so it cannot move windows that
belong to elevated programs; the MSI from the releases page (or
'winget install MoaidHathot.Shubbak') can. Run shubbak-wm elevated if you need
pre_uninstall: if (Get-Process shubbak-wm, taj, dalil, ayn -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & "$dir\shubbak.exe" stop }
